title: OLX Brazil Listings Scraper input
description: Start with the example search below, replace it with your OLX Brazil search URL, or clear it to search by keyword only. The example collects up to 3 listings from one page. Results are saved once per listing ID.

searchUrls.title: OLX search URLs
searchUrls.description: Paste search-result URLs copied from OLX Brazil to keep your category, location and filters. Replace the example URL with your own, or remove it when searching only by keyword.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Optional keywords searched across Brazil, for example iphone or apartamento. When URLs are also entered, both sets of searches run. Clear the example URL for a keyword-only search.

maxResults.title: Maximum listings
maxResults.description: Hard limit for unique listings saved across the whole run.

maxPagesPerSearch.title: Maximum pages per source
maxPagesPerSearch.description: Follow OLX's next-page link up to this many pages for each search URL or generated query URL.

maxPagesTotal.title: Maximum pages per run
maxPagesTotal.description: Global safety limit for pages requested across all search URLs and generated query URLs. Use this to control runtime and request volume for large batches.

includeDetails.title: Fetch listing details
includeDetails.description: Add available listing descriptions, additional photos, basic seller information and postal location from the listing page. Profile endpoint enrichment is a separate optional setting.

enrichProfiles.title: Enrich seller profiles (+$1 per 1,000 profiles)
enrichProfiles.description: Optional extra charge: $0.001 per unique seller profile per run when useful profile data with a public seller ID is saved. Partial profiles are billable; empty, blocked and unidentified profiles are not. Works independently of listing details. Disabled by default.
